2553f7de08e6ed69: Accounting and finance have an advantage over any other area when it comes to introducing agents: governance already exists. The person who enters transactions doesn’t approve them; the person who pays doesn’t reconcile them; the person who signs is accountable. These rules have been in audit manuals for decades. What’s missing is applying them to a worker that does exactly what the instructions say. This lesson takes the processes that currently consume a week at a firm or finance department and shows where the agent steps in and where it stops, always before the signature.
